# gh-1426: [GOAL] Model capability negotiation: layered context-window / max-output / thinking resolver with per-provider+model overrides in CLI and app settings ## Description ## Goal — Model capability negotiation (v1) One sentence: **every model fa talks to resolves its context window, max output tokens, and thinking level through ONE layered resolver — endpoint truth → shared catalog → per-provider+model user override → role slot → global cap — with the same override editable from the CLI /settings flow and the app settings, so a hand-coded 200k/16k catalog guess never strands a big-window, big-output, or thinking model again.** Today's pain, measured on fa main: `provider_catalog.dart:110-129` hand-hardcodes `contextWindow: 200000, maxTokens: 16384` for kimi/z.ai (the exact 200k/16k the owner sees); the thinking ladder is fully ported (`thinking.dart`, #273: budgets 1024/2048/8192/16384, `xhigh/max`→`high`) and config-reachable (#734: roles chain, `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`) but has **no chat-model surface in /settings and no per-model pin**; `CustomModelDefinition` accepts `contextWindow`/`maxTokens` but **no `thinkingLevel`**, and only for custom models — catalog models (glm, kimi, z.ai) have no override path at all; the only manual window correction is the GLOBAL `agent.contextWindowCap` (`settings_flow.dart:1935-2099`). ## Why this framing Not "add a thinking setting" (too thin — the same gap exists for window and output), not "auto-detect everything" (endpoints lie and users must be able to correct). The framing is a single precedence-resolved capability triple per (provider, model) — the convergent design all four references reached independently. ## Reference intelligence (pinned, per repo) - **pi** (`/references/pi`): code-generated catalog from **models.dev** (`scripts/generate-models.ts` → `models.generated.ts`); per-model user overrides in `models.json`; thinking config keys `defaultThinkingLevel` + `modelThinkingLevels` + `thinkingBudgets` + `"model:level"` CLI suffix; max output = catalog `maxTokens` clamped to window (floor 4096); unknown/custom models → **128000/16384 defaults**; adapter field selection (`max_tokens` vs `max_completion_tokens` vs `max_output_tokens` vs `maxOutputTokens`). - **oh-my-pi** (`/references/oh-my-pi`): layered pipeline models.json → SQLite cache → **models.dev/API discovery merge** → user `modelOverrides` → hardcoded policy fixes, **lazy re-probe after selection**; override shape `providers.

.modelOverrides..{contextWindow,maxTokens,thinking}` in `~/.omp/agent/models.yml`; **`maxContextWindow`** (extended context as a separate field) and **`omitMaxOutputTokens`** (endpoints that REJECT the field); per-model thinking gating `ThinkingConfig` (mode/efforts/effortMap/effortBudgets/effortRouting); merge precedence suffix > role > settings > model default; roles smol/slow/plan/tiny/advisor. - **kimi-code** (`/references/kimi-code`): 3-layer source (`/models` API → **persisted TOML**, models.dev snapshot, hardcoded anthropic output ceilings); **`max_context_size` required + build-time validated**; **`overrides` sub-table that SURVIVES catalog refreshes**; `[thinking]` section (enabled/effort/forced_effort/keep) + per-model `support_efforts`/`default_effort`/`off_effort`/`adaptive_thinking`; subagent-only role slots (`[secondary_model]`). - **codex** (`/references/codex`): server-driven `ModelInfo` catalog (`codex-rs/models-manager/`), **272k fallback record** for unknown slugs; `ReasoningEffort` None…Ultra/Custom, default Medium; keys `model_reasoning_effort` + **`plan_mode_reasoning_effort` (separate plan-role effort)** + `model_reasoning_summary` + `model_verbosity`; gating via catalog `supported_reasoning_levels`; mid-stream effort updates; `context_window`/`max_context_window` with 95% usable; user override `model_context_window` clamped to max; auto-compact at 90%; **max output REMOVED entirely** (Responses API manages it) — the compat lesson, not the design to copy. Convergence: layered resolution, models.dev-grade shared data, refresh-proof per-model user overrides, effort ladders with per-model gating, separate extended-window field. fa already owns the ladder (#273), the reserve math (16384), the remote+live catalog merge (`remote_catalog.dart`: fa1.dev JSON + `/v1/models`, endpoint wins, never blocks), and role slots — the missing 20% is the precedence resolver, the per-provider+model override section, and the two edit surfaces. ## Architecture **ModelCapabilityResolver** (pure function, one call): ``` resolve(provider, modelId, roleSlot?) → EffectiveCaps{ contextWindow, maxTokens, thinkingLevel, maxTokensField, omitMaxOutputTokens } ``` Layer precedence (first explicit value wins per field): 1. **per-provider+model user override** — `models: overrides: : : {contextWindow, maxTokens, thinkingLevel}` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` (kimi-style: survives every catalog refresh; strict `ConfigException` on bad shape, like every `models:` key today); 2. **endpoint-published truth** — `/v1/models` fields where the endpoint publishes them (already merged by `RemoteCatalogEnrichment`; extend to output caps where present); 3. **shared catalog** — remote fa1.dev catalog (existing), enriched toward models.dev-grade coverage; 4. **role slot** — `roles:` chain entries already accept `thinkingLevel` (#734); extend with the same cap keys, per slot (default/smol/slow/plan + media slots); 5. **global clamp** — `agent.contextWindowCap` applies LAST as today (#729 semantics preserved: clamp down, raise to served truth). Thinking precedence: model pin > role slot > global default > model-declared default; unsupported rung on a `reasoning:false` model → gated with a loud note (never silently sent). Compat: `maxTokensField` selection exists; add the `omitMaxOutputTokens` escape (omp/codex lesson: some endpoints reject the field). ## Capability surface (subject of every verb) | capability | acts on | shape | |---|---|---| | resolve | the **capability triple** for a (provider, model, role) | pure resolver, one precedence, property-tested | | override | **catalog models per provider+model** | `models: overrides:` section, refresh-proof, strict parse | | edit (CLI) | the **override entry** via /settings → model config → pick provider → pick model → caps | persisted to the same keys the resolver reads | | edit (app) | the **same override entry** in app settings screens | same config file, one source of truth (no parallel store) | | pin | **role slots** (smol/slow/plan + media) | same cap keys + thinkingLevel per slot; plan effort separable | | probe | the **endpoint's published caps** | existing remote-catalog merge, extended to output caps; lazy, never blocking | | gate | the **thinking rung** against the model's declared support | loud fallback note on mismatch | | omit | the **max-output field** for rejecting endpoints | `omitMaxOutputTokens` compat flag | Tiering: **core** = resolver + overrides section + CLI edit flow + app edit flow + role-slot cap keys + thinking serialization end-to-end + gating note. **Second tier** = models.dev-grade catalog enrichment, lazy re-probe after selection, `maxContextWindow` extended-context field, mid-stream effort updates, adaptive thinking, per-verbosity. **Excluded** (rationale each): removing max output entirely (codex's API manages it; our endpoints differ — glm/kimi need explicit caps), new model-picker UI (extend the existing `/model` + custom-provider flows), auto model selection (out of scope), prompt-content changes. ## Acceptance criteria (testable) - **AC1** — resolver precedence: for every field, the first explicit layer wins; a property test drives all 5 layers × set/unset combinations and asserts the winner (fixture table, no IO). - **AC2** — the owner's exact pain: with `models: overrides: zai: glm-5.3-flash: {maxTokens: 65536, thinkingLevel: high}`, the outbound request carries the raised cap and the level; the ctx meter and compaction thresholds see the same numbers (one resolver, three consumers). - **AC3** — CLI edit flow: /settings → model config → provider → model → caps persists exactly the resolver's override keys; the OpenAI-completions adapter sends `max_completion_tokens`/`reasoning_effort`, the Google adapter maps the pinned level onto `thinkingLevel`. ### Key decisions - Resolver is a pure function over (provider, modelId, spec, override) — unit-tested precedence, no I/O - Overrides live only in user config, so they survive remote-catalog refreshes - Fixed two bugs found by the flow IT tests: removing the last override no longer discards the edit (the validator threw on the valid absent `models:` section — save path and live-apply both treated absent as empty), and the caps menu re-reads entries every iteration (a pre-loop snapshot kept listing a just-removed override) ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/model_roles/ test/providers/capability_wire_test.dart test/cli/settings_flow_model_caps_test.dart ``` - Note: the full suite on this CI runner shows pre-existing failures unrelated to the change — `browser_ext/*` (Chrome needs a DBus the runner lacks) and the PTY tests `subagent_integration_test.dart` / `dap_chatter_loop_test.dart` (the former fails identically on a pristine `origin/main` worktree; the latter is load-sensitive). All model_roles/provider/cli-flow suites pass.
Architecture ```mermaid flowchart TD YAML[~/.fah/config.yaml
models.overrides] --> RES[CapabilityResolver] CAT[Remote catalog
model + provider defaults] --> RES RES -->|gated caps| M[Model] M --> OAI[openai_completions
max_completion_tokens / reasoning_effort] M --> G[google
thinkingLevel] FLOW[/settings Model capabilities flow/] -->|validated upsert + live reload| YAML ```

# gh-1426: [GOAL] Model capability negotiation: layered context-window / max-output / thinking resolver with per-provider+model overrides in CLI and app settings ## Description ## Goal — Model capability negotiation (v1) One sentence: **every model fa talks to resolves its context window, max output tokens, and thinking level through ONE layered resolver — endpoint truth → shared catalog → per-provider+model user override → role slot → global cap — with the same override editable from the CLI /settings flow and the app settings, so a hand-coded 200k/16k catalog guess never strands a big-window, big-output, or thinking model again.** Today's pain, measured on fa main: `provider_catalog.dart:110-129` hand-hardcodes `contextWindow: 200000, maxTokens: 16384` for kimi/z.ai (the exact 200k/16k the owner sees); the thinking ladder is fully ported (`thinking.dart`, #273: budgets 1024/2048/8192/16384, `xhigh/max`→`high`) and config-reachable (#734: roles chain, `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`) but has **no chat-model surface in /settings and no per-model pin**; `CustomModelDefinition` accepts `contextWindow`/`maxTokens` but **no `thinkingLevel`**, and only for custom models — catalog models (glm, kimi, z.ai) have no override path at all; the only manual window correction is the GLOBAL `agent.contextWindowCap` (`settings_flow.dart:1935-2099`). ## Why this framing Not "add a thinking setting" (too thin — the same gap exists for window and output), not "auto-detect everything" (endpoints lie and users must be able to correct). The framing is a single precedence-resolved capability triple per (provider, model) — the convergent design all four references reached independently. ## Reference intelligence (pinned, per repo) - **pi** (`/references/pi`): code-generated catalog from **models.dev** (`scripts/generate-models.ts` → `models.generated.ts`); per-model user overrides in `models.json`; thinking config keys `defaultThinkingLevel` + `modelThinkingLevels` + `thinkingBudgets` + `"model:level"` CLI suffix; max output = catalog `maxTokens` clamped to window (floor 4096); unknown/custom models → **128000/16384 defaults**; adapter field selection (`max_tokens` vs `max_completion_tokens` vs `max_output_tokens` vs `maxOutputTokens`). - **oh-my-pi** (`/references/oh-my-pi`): layered pipeline models.json → SQLite cache → **models.dev/API discovery merge** → user `modelOverrides` → hardcoded policy fixes, **lazy re-probe after selection**; override shape `providers.

.modelOverrides..{contextWindow,maxTokens,thinking}` in `~/.omp/agent/models.yml`; **`maxContextWindow`** (extended context as a separate field) and **`omitMaxOutputTokens`** (endpoints that REJECT the field); per-model thinking gating `ThinkingConfig` (mode/efforts/effortMap/effortBudgets/effortRouting); merge precedence suffix > role > settings > model default; roles smol/slow/plan/tiny/advisor. - **kimi-code** (`/references/kimi-code`): 3-layer source (`/models` API → **persisted TOML**, models.dev snapshot, hardcoded anthropic output ceilings); **`max_context_size` required + build-time validated**; **`overrides` sub-table that SURVIVES catalog refreshes**; `[thinking]` section (enabled/effort/forced_effort/keep) + per-model `support_efforts`/`default_effort`/`off_effort`/`adaptive_thinking`; subagent-only role slots (`[secondary_model]`). - **codex** (`/references/codex`): server-driven `ModelInfo` catalog (`codex-rs/models-manager/`), **272k fallback record** for unknown slugs; `ReasoningEffort` None…Ultra/Custom, default Medium; keys `model_reasoning_effort` + **`plan_mode_reasoning_effort` (separate plan-role effort)** + `model_reasoning_summary` + `model_verbosity`; gating via catalog `supported_reasoning_levels`; mid-stream effort updates; `context_window`/`max_context_window` with 95% usable; user override `model_context_window` clamped to max; auto-compact at 90%; **max output REMOVED entirely** (Responses API manages it) — the compat lesson, not the design to copy. Convergence: layered resolution, models.dev-grade shared data, refresh-proof per-model user overrides, effort ladders with per-model gating, separate extended-window field. fa already owns the ladder (#273), the reserve math (16384), the remote+live catalog merge (`remote_catalog.dart`: fa1.dev JSON + `/v1/models`, endpoint wins, never blocks), and role slots — the missing 20% is the precedence resolver, the per-provider+model override section, and the two edit surfaces. ## Architecture **ModelCapabilityResolver** (pure function, one call): ``` resolve(provider, modelId, roleSlot?) → EffectiveCaps{ contextWindow, maxTokens, thinkingLevel, maxTokensField, omitMaxOutputTokens } ``` Layer precedence (first explicit value wins per field): 1. **per-provider+model user override** — `models: overrides: : : {contextWindow, maxTokens, thinkingLevel}` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` (kimi-style: survives every catalog refresh; strict `ConfigException` on bad shape, like every `models:` key today); 2. **endpoint-published truth** — `/v1/models` fields where the endpoint publishes them (already merged by `RemoteCatalogEnrichment`; extend to output caps where present); 3. **shared catalog** — remote fa1.dev catalog (existing), enriched toward models.dev-grade coverage; 4. **role slot** — `roles:` chain entries already accept `thinkingLevel` (#734); extend with the same cap keys, per slot (default/smol/slow/plan + media slots); 5. **global clamp** — `agent.contextWindowCap` applies LAST as today (#729 semantics preserved: clamp down, raise to served truth). Thinking precedence: model pin > role slot > global default > model-declared default; unsupported rung on a `reasoning:false` model → gated with a loud note (never silently sent). Compat: `maxTokensField` selection exists; add the `omitMaxOutputTokens` escape (omp/codex lesson: some endpoints reject the field). ## Capability surface (subject of every verb) | capability | acts on | shape | |---|---|---| | resolve | the **capability triple** for a (provider, model, role) | pure resolver, one precedence, property-tested | | override | **catalog models per provider+model** | `models: overrides:` section, refresh-proof, strict parse | | edit (CLI) | the **override entry** via /settings → model config → pick provider → pick model → caps | persisted to the same keys the resolver reads | | edit (app) | the **same override entry** in app settings screens | same config file, one source of truth (no parallel store) | | pin | **role slots** (smol/slow/plan + media) | same cap keys + thinkingLevel per slot; plan effort separable | | probe | the **endpoint's published caps** | existing remote-catalog merge, extended to output caps; lazy, never blocking | | gate | the **thinking rung** against the model's declared support | loud fallback note on mismatch | | omit | the **max-output field** for rejecting endpoints | `omitMaxOutputTokens` compat flag | Tiering: **core** = resolver + overrides section + CLI edit flow + app edit flow + role-slot cap keys + thinking serialization end-to-end + gating note. **Second tier** = models.dev-grade catalog enrichment, lazy re-probe after selection, `maxContextWindow` extended-context field, mid-stream effort updates, adaptive thinking, per-verbosity. **Excluded** (rationale each): removing max output entirely (codex's API manages it; our endpoints differ — glm/kimi need explicit caps), new model-picker UI (extend the existing `/model` + custom-provider flows), auto model selection (out of scope), prompt-content changes. ## Acceptance criteria (testable) - **AC1** — resolver precedence: for every field, the first explicit layer wins; a property test drives all 5 layers × set/unset combinations and asserts the winner (fixture table, no IO). - **AC2** — the owner's exact pain: with `models: overrides: zai: glm-5.3-flash: {maxTokens: 65536, thinkingLevel: high}`, the outbound request carries the raised cap and the level; the ctx meter and compaction thresholds see the same numbers (one resolver, three consumers). - **AC3** — CLI edit flow: /settings → model config → provider → model → caps persists exactly the resolver's override keys; # gh-1426: [GOAL] Model capability negotiation: layered context-window / max-output / thinking resolver with per-provider+model overrides in CLI and app settings ## Description ## Goal — Model capability negotiation (v1) One sentence: **every model fa talks to resolves its context window, max output tokens, and thinking level through ONE layered resolver — endpoint truth → shared catalog → per-provider+model user override → role slot → global cap — with the same override editable from the CLI /settings flow and the app settings, so a hand-coded 200k/16k catalog guess never strands a big-window, big-output, or thinking model again.** Today's pain, measured on fa main: `provider_catalog.dart:110-129` hand-hardcodes `contextWindow: 200000, maxTokens: 16384` for kimi/z.ai (the exact 200k/16k the owner sees); the thinking ladder is fully ported (`thinking.dart`, #273: budgets 1024/2048/8192/16384, `xhigh/max`→`high`) and config-reachable (#734: roles chain, `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`) but has **no chat-model surface in /settings and no per-model pin**; `CustomModelDefinition` accepts `contextWindow`/`maxTokens` but **no `thinkingLevel`**, and only for custom models — catalog models (glm, kimi, z.ai) have no override path at all; the only manual window correction is the GLOBAL `agent.contextWindowCap` (`settings_flow.dart:1935-2099`). ## Why this framing Not "add a thinking setting" (too thin — the same gap exists for window and output), not "auto-detect everything" (endpoints lie and users must be able to correct). The framing is a single precedence-resolved capability triple per (provider, model) — the convergent design all four references reached independently. ## Reference intelligence (pinned, per repo) - **pi** (`/references/pi`): code-generated catalog from **models.dev** (`scripts/generate-models.ts` → `models.generated.ts`); per-model user overrides in `models.json`; thinking config keys `defaultThinkingLevel` + `modelThinkingLevels` + `thinkingBudgets` + `"model:level"` CLI suffix; max output = catalog `maxTokens` clamped to window (floor 4096); unknown/custom models → **128000/16384 defaults**; adapter field selection (`max_tokens` vs `max_completion_tokens` vs `max_output_tokens` vs `maxOutputTokens`). - **oh-my-pi** (`/references/oh-my-pi`): layered pipeline models.json → SQLite cache → **models.dev/API discovery merge** → user `modelOverrides` → hardcoded policy fixes, **lazy re-probe after selection**; override shape `providers.

.modelOverrides..{contextWindow,maxTokens,thinking}` in `~/.omp/agent/models.yml`; **`maxContextWindow`** (extended context as a separate field) and **`omitMaxOutputTokens`** (endpoints that REJECT the field); per-model thinking gating `ThinkingConfig` (mode/efforts/effortMap/effortBudgets/effortRouting); merge precedence suffix > role > settings > model default; roles smol/slow/plan/tiny/advisor. - **kimi-code** (`/references/kimi-code`): 3-layer source (`/models` API → **persisted TOML**, models.dev snapshot, hardcoded anthropic output ceilings); **`max_context_size` required + build-time validated**; **`overrides` sub-table that SURVIVES catalog refreshes**; `[thinking]` section (enabled/effort/forced_effort/keep) + per-model `support_efforts`/`default_effort`/`off_effort`/`adaptive_thinking`; subagent-only role slots (`[secondary_model]`). - **codex** (`/references/codex`): server-driven `ModelInfo` catalog (`codex-rs/models-manager/`), **272k fallback record** for unknown slugs; `ReasoningEffort` None…Ultra/Custom, default Medium; keys `model_reasoning_effort` + **`plan_mode_reasoning_effort` (separate plan-role effort)** + `model_reasoning_summary` + `model_verbosity`; gating via catalog `supported_reasoning_levels`; mid-stream effort updates; `context_window`/`max_context_window` with 95% usable; user override `model_context_window` clamped to max; auto-compact at 90%; **max output REMOVED entirely** (Responses API manages it) — the compat lesson, not the design to copy. Convergence: layered resolution, models.dev-grade shared data, refresh-proof per-model user overrides, effort ladders with per-model gating, separate extended-window field. fa already owns the ladder (#273), the reserve math (16384), the remote+live catalog merge (`remote_catalog.dart`: fa1.dev JSON + `/v1/models`, endpoint wins, never blocks), and role slots — the missing 20% is the precedence resolver, the per-provider+model override section, and the two edit surfaces. ## Architecture **ModelCapabilityResolver** (pure function, one call): ``` resolve(provider, modelId, roleSlot?) → EffectiveCaps{ contextWindow, maxTokens, thinkingLevel, maxTokensField, omitMaxOutputTokens } ``` Layer precedence (first explicit value wins per field): 1. **per-provider+model user override** — `models: overrides: : : {contextWindow, maxTokens, thinkingLevel}` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` (kimi-style: survives every catalog refresh; strict `ConfigException` on bad shape, like every `models:` key today); 2. **endpoint-published truth** — `/v1/models` fields where the endpoint publishes them (already merged by `RemoteCatalogEnrichment`; extend to output caps where present); 3. **shared catalog** — remote fa1.dev catalog (existing), enriched toward models.dev-grade coverage; 4. **role slot** — `roles:` chain entries already accept `thinkingLevel` (#734); extend with the same cap keys, per slot (default/smol/slow/plan + media slots); 5. **global clamp** — `agent.contextWindowCap` applies LAST as today (#729 semantics preserved: clamp down, raise to served truth). Thinking precedence: model pin > role slot > global default > model-declared default; unsupported rung on a `reasoning:false` model → gated with a loud note (never silently sent). Compat: `maxTokensField` selection exists; add the `omitMaxOutputTokens` escape (omp/codex lesson: some endpoints reject the field). ## Capability surface (subject of every verb) | capability | acts on | shape | |---|---|---| | resolve | the **capability triple** for a (provider, model, role) | pure resolver, one precedence, property-tested | | override | **catalog models per provider+model** | `models: overrides:` section, refresh-proof, strict parse | | edit (CLI) | the **override entry** via /settings → model config → pick provider → pick model → caps | persisted to the same keys the resolver reads | | edit (app) | the **same override entry** in app settings screens | same config file, one source of truth (no parallel store) | | pin | **role slots** (smol/slow/plan + media) | same cap keys + thinkingLevel per slot; plan effort separable | | probe | the **endpoint's published caps** | existing remote-catalog merge, extended to output caps; lazy, never blocking | | gate | the **thinking rung** against the model's declared support | loud fallback note on mismatch | | omit | the **max-output field** for rejecting endpoints | `omitMaxOutputTokens` compat flag | Tiering: **core** = resolver + overrides section + CLI edit flow + app edit flow + role-slot cap keys + thinking serialization end-to-end + gating note. **Second tier** = models.dev-grade catalog enrichment, lazy re-probe after selection, `maxContextWindow` extended-context field, mid-stream effort updates, adaptive thinking, per-verbosity. **Excluded** (rationale each): removing max output entirely (codex's API manages it; our endpoints differ — glm/kimi need explicit caps), new model-picker UI (extend the existing `/model` + custom-provider flows), auto model selection (out of scope), prompt-content changes. ## Acceptance criteria (testable) - **AC1** — resolver precedence: for every field, the first explicit layer wins; a property test drives all 5 layers × set/unset combinations and asserts the winner (fixture table, no IO). - **AC2** — the owner's exact pain: with `models: overrides: zai: glm-5.3-flash: {maxTokens: 65536, thinkingLevel: high}`, the outbound request carries the raised cap and the level; the ctx meter and compaction thresholds see the same numbers (one resolver, three consumers). - **AC3** — CLI edit flow: /settings → model config → provider → model → caps persists exactly the resolver's override keys; # gh-1426: [GOAL] Model capability negotiation: layered context-window / max-output / thinking resolver with per-provider+model overrides in CLI and app settings ## Description ## Goal — Model capability negotiation (v1) One sentence: **every model fa talks to resolves its context window, max output tokens, and thinking level through ONE layered resolver — endpoint truth → shared catalog → per-provider+model user override → role slot → global cap — with the same override editable from the CLI /settings flow and the app settings, so a hand-coded 200k/16k catalog guess never strands a big-window, big-output, or thinking model again.** Today's pain, measured on fa main: `provider_catalog.dart:110-129` hand-hardcodes `contextWindow: 200000, maxTokens: 16384` for kimi/z.ai (the exact 200k/16k the owner sees); the thinking ladder is fully ported (`thinking.dart`, #273: budgets 1024/2048/8192/16384, `xhigh/max`→`high`) and config-reachable (#734: roles chain, `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`) but has **no chat-model surface in /settings and no per-model pin**; `CustomModelDefinition` accepts `contextWindow`/`maxTokens` but **no `thinkingLevel`**, and only for custom models — catalog models (glm, kimi, z.ai) have no override path at all; the only manual window correction is the GLOBAL `agent.contextWindowCap` (`settings_flow.dart:1935-2099`). ## Why this framing Not "add a thinking setting" (too thin — the same gap exists for window and output), not "auto-detect everything" (endpoints lie and users must be able to correct). The framing is a single precedence-resolved capability triple per (provider, model) — the convergent design all four references reached independently. ## Reference intelligence (pinned, per repo) - **pi** (`/references/pi`): code-generated catalog from **models.dev** (`scripts/generate-models.ts` → `models.generated.ts`); per-model user overrides in `models.json`; thinking config keys `defaultThinkingLevel` + `modelThinkingLevels` + `thinkingBudgets` + `"model:level"` CLI suffix; max output = catalog `maxTokens` clamped to window (floor 4096); unknown/custom models → **128000/16384 defaults**; adapter field selection (`max_tokens` vs `max_completion_tokens` vs `max_output_tokens` vs `maxOutputTokens`). - **oh-my-pi** (`/references/oh-my-pi`): layered pipeline models.json → SQLite cache → **models.dev/API discovery merge** → user `modelOverrides` → hardcoded policy fixes, **lazy re-probe after selection**; override shape `providers.

.modelOverrides..{contextWindow,maxTokens,thinking}` in `~/.omp/agent/models.yml`; **`maxContextWindow`** (extended context as a separate field) and **`omitMaxOutputTokens`** (endpoints that REJECT the field); per-model thinking gating `ThinkingConfig` (mode/efforts/effortMap/effortBudgets/effortRouting); merge precedence suffix > role > settings > model default; roles smol/slow/plan/tiny/advisor. - **kimi-code** (`/references/kimi-code`): 3-layer source (`/models` API → **persisted TOML**, models.dev snapshot, hardcoded anthropic output ceilings); **`max_context_size` required + build-time validated**; **`overrides` sub-table that SURVIVES catalog refreshes**; `[thinking]` section (enabled/effort/forced_effort/keep) + per-model `support_efforts`/`default_effort`/`off_effort`/`adaptive_thinking`; subagent-only role slots (`[secondary_model]`). - **codex** (`/references/codex`): server-driven `ModelInfo` catalog (`codex-rs/models-manager/`), **272k fallback record** for unknown slugs; `ReasoningEffort` None…Ultra/Custom, default Medium; keys `model_reasoning_effort` + **`plan_mode_reasoning_effort` (separate plan-role effort)** + `model_reasoning_summary` + `model_verbosity`; gating via catalog `supported_reasoning_levels`; mid-stream effort updates; `context_window`/`max_context_window` with 95% usable; user override `model_context_window` clamped to max; auto-compact at 90%; **max output REMOVED entirely** (Responses API manages it) — the compat lesson, not the design to copy. Convergence: layered resolution, models.dev-grade shared data, refresh-proof per-model user overrides, effort ladders with per-model gating, separate extended-window field. fa already owns the ladder (#273), the reserve math (16384), the remote+live catalog merge (`remote_catalog.dart`: fa1.dev JSON + `/v1/models`, endpoint wins, never blocks), and role slots — the missing 20% is the precedence resolver, the per-provider+model override section, and the two edit surfaces. ## Architecture **ModelCapabilityResolver** (pure function, one call): ``` resolve(provider, modelId, roleSlot?) → EffectiveCaps{ contextWindow, maxTokens, thinkingLevel, maxTokensField, omitMaxOutputTokens } ``` Layer precedence (first explicit value wins per field): 1. **per-provider+model user override** — `models: overrides: : : {contextWindow, maxTokens, thinkingLevel}` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` (kimi-style: survives every catalog refresh; strict `ConfigException` on bad shape, like every `models:` key today); 2. **endpoint-published truth** — `/v1/models` fields where the endpoint publishes them (already merged by `RemoteCatalogEnrichment`; extend to output caps where present); 3. **shared catalog** — remote fa1.dev catalog (existing), enriched toward models.dev-grade coverage; 4. **role slot** — `roles:` chain entries already accept `thinkingLevel` (#734); extend with the same cap keys, per slot (default/smol/slow/plan + media slots); 5. **global clamp** — `agent.contextWindowCap` applies LAST as today (#729 semantics preserved: clamp down, raise to served truth). Thinking precedence: model pin > role slot > global default > model-declared default; unsupported rung on a `reasoning:false` model → gated with a loud note (never silently sent). Compat: `maxTokensField` selection exists; add the `omitMaxOutputTokens` escape (omp/codex lesson: some endpoints reject the field). ## Capability surface (subject of every verb) | capability | acts on | shape | |---|---|---| | resolve | the **capability triple** for a (provider, model, role) | pure resolver, one precedence, property-tested | | override | **catalog models per provider+model** | `models: overrides:` section, refresh-proof, strict parse | | edit (CLI) | the **override entry** via /settings → model config → pick provider → pick model → caps | persisted to the same keys the resolver reads | | edit (app) | the **same override entry** in app settings screens | same config file, one source of truth (no parallel store) | | pin | **role slots** (smol/slow/plan + media) | same cap keys + thinkingLevel per slot; plan effort separable | | probe | the **endpoint's published caps** | existing remote-catalog merge, extended to output caps; lazy, never blocking | | gate | the **thinking rung** against the model's declared support | loud fallback note on mismatch | | omit | the **max-output field** for rejecting endpoints | `omitMaxOutputTokens` compat flag | Tiering: **core** = resolver + overrides section + CLI edit flow + app edit flow + role-slot cap keys + thinking serialization end-to-end + gating note. **Second tier** = models.dev-grade catalog enrichment, lazy re-probe after selection, `maxContextWindow` extended-context field, mid-stream effort updates, adaptive thinking, per-verbosity. **Excluded** (rationale each): removing max output entirely (codex's API manages it; our endpoints differ — glm/kimi need explicit caps), new model-picker UI (extend the existing `/model` + custom-provider flows), auto model selection (out of scope), prompt-content changes. ## Acceptance criteria (testable) - **AC1** — resolver precedence: for every field, the first explicit layer wins; a property test drives all 5 layers × set/unset combinations and asserts the winner (fixture table, no IO). - **AC2** — the owner's exact pain: with `models: overrides: zai: glm-5.3-flash: {maxTokens: 65536, thinkingLevel: high}`, the outbound request carries the raised cap and the level; the ctx meter and compaction thresholds see the same numbers (one resolver, three consumers). - **AC3** — CLI edit flow: /settings → model config → provider → model → caps persists exactly the resolver's override keys; # gh-1426: [GOAL] Model capability negotiation: layered context-window / max-output / thinking resolver with per-provider+model overrides in CLI and app settings ## Description ## Goal — Model capability negotiation (v1) One sentence: **every model fa talks to resolves its context window, max output tokens, and thinking level through ONE layered resolver — endpoint truth → shared catalog → per-provider+model user override → role slot → global cap — with the same override editable from the CLI /settings flow and the app settings, so a hand-coded 200k/16k catalog guess never strands a big-window, big-output, or thinking model again.** Today's pain, measured on fa main: `provider_catalog.dart:110-129` hand-hardcodes `contextWindow: 200000, maxTokens: 16384` for kimi/z.ai (the exact 200k/16k the owner sees); the thinking ladder is fully ported (`thinking.dart`, #273: budgets 1024/2048/8192/16384, `xhigh/max`→`high`) and config-reachable (#734: roles chain, `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`) but has **no chat-model surface in /settings and no per-model pin**; `CustomModelDefinition` accepts `contextWindow`/`maxTokens` but **no `thinkingLevel`**, and only for custom models — catalog models (glm, kimi, z.ai) have no override path at all; the only manual window correction is the GLOBAL `agent.contextWindowCap` (`settings_flow.dart:1935-2099`). ## Why this framing Not "add a thinking setting" (too thin — the same gap exists for window and output), not "auto-detect everything" (endpoints lie and users must be able to correct). The framing is a single precedence-resolved capability triple per (provider, model) — the convergent design all four references reached independently. ## Reference intelligence (pinned, per repo) - **pi** (`/references/pi`): code-generated catalog from **models.dev** (`scripts/generate-models.ts` → `models.generated.ts`); per-model user overrides in `models.json`; thinking config keys `defaultThinkingLevel` + `modelThinkingLevels` + `thinkingBudgets` + `"model:level"` CLI suffix; max output = catalog `maxTokens` clamped to window (floor 4096); unknown/custom models → **128000/16384 defaults**; adapter field selection (`max_tokens` vs `max_completion_tokens` vs `max_output_tokens` vs `maxOutputTokens`). - **oh-my-pi** (`/references/oh-my-pi`): layered pipeline models.json → SQLite cache → **models.dev/API discovery merge** → user `modelOverrides` → hardcoded policy fixes, **lazy re-probe after selection**; override shape `providers.

.modelOverrides..{contextWindow,maxTokens,thinking}` in `~/.omp/agent/models.yml`; **`maxContextWindow`** (extended context as a separate field) and **`omitMaxOutputTokens`** (endpoints that REJECT the field); per-model thinking gating `ThinkingConfig` (mode/efforts/effortMap/effortBudgets/effortRouting); merge precedence suffix > role > settings > model default; roles smol/slow/plan/tiny/advisor. - **kimi-code** (`/references/kimi-code`): 3-layer source (`/models` API → **persisted TOML**, models.dev snapshot, hardcoded anthropic output ceilings); **`max_context_size` required + build-time validated**; **`overrides` sub-table that SURVIVES catalog refreshes**; `[thinking]` section (enabled/effort/forced_effort/keep) + per-model `support_efforts`/`default_effort`/`off_effort`/`adaptive_thinking`; subagent-only role slots (`[secondary_model]`). - **codex** (`/references/codex`): server-driven `ModelInfo` catalog (`codex-rs/models-manager/`), **272k fallback record** for unknown slugs; `ReasoningEffort` None…Ultra/Custom, default Medium; keys `model_reasoning_effort` + **`plan_mode_reasoning_effort` (separate plan-role effort)** + `model_reasoning_summary` + `model_verbosity`; gating via catalog `supported_reasoning_levels`; mid-stream effort updates; `context_window`/`max_context_window` with 95% usable; user override `model_context_window` clamped to max; auto-compact at 90%; **max output REMOVED entirely** (Responses API manages it) — the compat lesson, not the design to copy. Convergence: layered resolution, models.dev-grade shared data, refresh-proof per-model user overrides, effort ladders with per-model gating, separate extended-window field. fa already owns the ladder (#273), the reserve math (16384), the remote+live catalog merge (`remote_catalog.dart`: fa1.dev JSON + `/v1/models`, endpoint wins, never blocks), and role slots — the missing 20% is the precedence resolver, the per-provider+model override section, and the two edit surfaces. ## Architecture **ModelCapabilityResolver** (pure function, one call): ``` resolve(provider, modelId, roleSlot?) → EffectiveCaps{ contextWindow, maxTokens, thinkingLevel, maxTokensField, omitMaxOutputTokens } ``` Layer precedence (first explicit value wins per field): 1. **per-provider+model user override** — `models: overrides: : : {contextWindow, maxTokens, thinkingLevel}` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` (kimi-style: survives every catalog refresh; strict `ConfigException` on bad shape, like every `models:` key today); 2. **endpoint-published truth** — `/v1/models` fields where the endpoint publishes them (already merged by `RemoteCatalogEnrichment`; extend to output caps where present); 3. **shared catalog** — remote fa1.dev catalog (existing), enriched toward models.dev-grade coverage; 4. **role slot** — `roles:` chain entries already accept `thinkingLevel` (#734); extend with the same cap keys, per slot (default/smol/slow/plan + media slots); 5. **global clamp** — `agent.contextWindowCap` applies LAST as today (#729 semantics preserved: clamp down, raise to served truth). Thinking precedence: model pin > role slot > global default > model-declared default; unsupported rung on a `reasoning:false` model → gated with a loud note (never silently sent). Compat: `maxTokensField` selection exists; add the `omitMaxOutputTokens` escape (omp/codex lesson: some endpoints reject the field). ## Capability surface (subject of every verb) | capability | acts on | shape | |---|---|---| | resolve | the **capability triple** for a (provider, model, role) | pure resolver, one precedence, property-tested | | override | **catalog models per provider+model** | `models: overrides:` section, refresh-proof, strict parse | | edit (CLI) | the **override entry** via /settings → model config → pick provider → pick model → caps | persisted to the same keys the resolver reads | | edit (app) | the **same override entry** in app settings screens | same config file, one source of truth (no parallel store) | | pin | **role slots** (smol/slow/plan + media) | same cap keys + thinkingLevel per slot; plan effort separable | | probe | the **endpoint's published caps** | existing remote-catalog merge, extended to output caps; lazy, never blocking | | gate | the **thinking rung** against the model's declared support | loud fallback note on mismatch | | omit | the **max-output field** for rejecting endpoints | `omitMaxOutputTokens` compat flag | Tiering: **core** = resolver + overrides section + CLI edit flow + app edit flow + role-slot cap keys + thinking serialization end-to-end + gating note. **Second tier** = models.dev-grade catalog enrichment, lazy re-probe after selection, `maxContextWindow` extended-context field, mid-stream effort updates, adaptive thinking, per-verbosity. **Excluded** (rationale each): removing max output entirely (codex's API manages it; our endpoints differ — glm/kimi need explicit caps), new model-picker UI (extend the existing `/model` + custom-provider flows), auto model selection (out of scope), prompt-content changes. ## Acceptance criteria (testable) - **AC1** — resolver precedence: for every field, the first explicit layer wins; a property test drives all 5 layers × set/unset combinations and asserts the winner (fixture table, no IO). - **AC2** — the owner's exact pain: with `models: overrides: zai: glm-5.3-flash: {maxTokens: 65536, thinkingLevel: high}`, the outbound request carries the raised cap and the level; the ctx meter and compaction thresholds see the same numbers (one resolver, three consumers). - **AC3** — CLI edit flow: /settings → model config → provider → model → caps persists exactly the resolver's override keys; # gh-1426: [GOAL] Model capability negotiation: layered context-window / max-output / thinking resolver with per-provider+model overrides in CLI and app settings ## Description ## Goal — Model capability negotiation (v1) One sentence: **every model fa talks to resolves its context window, max output tokens, and thinking level through ONE layered resolver — endpoint truth → shared catalog → per-provider+model user override → role slot → global cap — with the same override editable from the CLI /settings flow and the app settings, so a hand-coded 200k/16k catalog guess never strands a big-window, big-output, or thinking model again.** Today's pain, measured on fa main: `provider_catalog.dart:110-129` hand-hardcodes `contextWindow: 200000, maxTokens: 16384` for kimi/z.ai (the exact 200k/16k the owner sees); the thinking ladder is fully ported (`thinking.dart`, #273: budgets 1024/2048/8192/16384, `xhigh/max`→`high`) and config-reachable (#734: roles chain, `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`) but has **no chat-model surface in /settings and no per-model pin**; `CustomModelDefinition` accepts `contextWindow`/`maxTokens` but **no `thinkingLevel`**, and only for custom models — catalog models (glm, kimi, z.ai) have no override path at all; the only manual window correction is the GLOBAL `agent.contextWindowCap` (`settings_flow.dart:1935-2099`). ## Why this framing Not "add a thinking setting" (too thin — the same gap exists for window and output), not "auto-detect everything" (endpoints lie and users must be able to correct). Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. Outputs Write the standard review artifacts: - `outputs/pr_review.json` — structured data with `recommendation`, `summary`, `inlineComments`, `issueCounts` - `outputs/pr_review_general.md` — 1-2 paragraph general PR comment - `outputs/pr_review_comments/*.md` — one file per detailed inline comment **Inline comment lines must be present in the PR diff.** GitHub review threads can only be attached to added or context lines inside a diff hunk. If `pr_diff.txt` is truncated, run `git diff origin/{baseBranch}...HEAD` to locate the correct line numbers. Findings on unchanged code outside the diff belong in `outputs/pr_review_general.md`, not as inline comments. Do NOT write `outputs/response.md`; the review is posted to GitHub only. ```mermaid flowchart TD O1["Write outputs/pr_review.json — structured data for GitHub PR review…

blocks.text:
# gh-1426: [GOAL] Model capability negotiation: layered context-window / max-output / thinking resolver with per-provider+model overrides in CLI and app settings ## Description ## Goal — Model capability negotiation (v1) One sentence: **every model fa talks to resolves its context window, max output tokens, and thinking level through ONE layered resolver — endpoint truth → shared catalog → per-provider+model user override → role slot → global cap — with the same override editable from the CLI /settings flow and the app settings, so a hand-coded 200k/16k catalog guess never strands a big-window, big-output, or thinking model again.** Today's pain, measured on fa main: `provider_catalog.dart:110-129` hand-hardcodes `contextWindow: 200000, maxTokens: 16384` for kimi/z.ai (the exact 200k/16k the owner sees); the thinking ladder is fully ported (`thinking.dart`, #273: budgets 1024/2048/8192/16384, `xhigh/max`→`high`) and config-reachable (#734: roles chain, `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`) but has **no chat-model surface in /settings and no per-model pin**; `CustomModelDefinition` accepts `contextWindow`/`maxTokens` but **no `thinkingLevel`**, and only for custom models — catalog models (glm, kimi, z.ai) have no override path at all; the only manual window correction is the GLOBAL `agent.contextWindowCap` (`settings_flow.dart:1935-2099`). ## Why this framing Not "add a thinking setting" (too thin — the same gap exists for window and output), not "auto-detect everything" (endpoints lie and users must be able to correct). The framing is a single precedence-resolved capability triple per (provider, model) — the convergent design all four references reached independently. ## Reference intelligence (pinned, per repo) - **pi** (`/references/pi`): code-generated catalog from **models.dev** (`scripts/generate-models.ts` → `models.generated.ts`); per-model user overrides in `models.json`; thinking config keys `defaultThinkingLevel` + `modelThinkingLevels` + `thinkingBudgets` + `"model:level"` CLI suffix; max output = catalog `maxTokens` clamped to window (floor 4096); unknown/custom models → **128000/16384 defaults**; adapter field selection (`max_tokens` vs `max_completion_tokens` vs `max_output_tokens` vs `maxOutputTokens`). - **oh-my-pi** (`/references/oh-my-pi`): layered pipeline models.json → SQLite cache → **models.dev/API discovery merge** → user `modelOverrides` → hardcoded policy fixes, **lazy re-probe after selection**; override shape `providers.

.modelOverrides..{contextWindow,maxTokens,thinking}` in `~/.omp/agent/models.yml`; **`maxContextWindow`** (extended context as a separate field) and **`omitMaxOutputTokens`** (endpoints that REJECT the field); per-model thinking gating `ThinkingConfig` (mode/efforts/effortMap/effortBudgets/effortRouting); merge precedence suffix > role > settings > model default; roles smol/slow/plan/tiny/advisor. - **kimi-code** (`/references/kimi-code`): 3-layer source (`/models` API → **persisted TOML**, models.dev snapshot, hardcoded anthropic output ceilings); **`max_context_size` required + build-time validated**; **`overrides` sub-table that SURVIVES catalog refreshes**; `[thinking]` section (enabled/effort/forced_effort/keep) + per-model `support_efforts`/`default_effort`/`off_effort`/`adaptive_thinking`; subagent-only role slots (`[secondary_model]`). - **codex** (`/references/codex`): server-driven `ModelInfo` catalog (`codex-rs/models-manager/`), **272k fallback record** for unknown slugs; `ReasoningEffort` None…Ultra/Custom, default Medium; keys `model_reasoning_effort` + **`plan_mode_reasoning_effort` (separate plan-role effort)** + `model_reasoning_summary` + `model_verbosity`; gating via catalog `supported_reasoning_levels`; mid-stream effort updates; `context_window`/`max_context_window` with 95% usable; user override `model_context_window` clamped to max; auto-compact at 90%; **max output REMOVED entirely** (Responses API manages it) — the compat lesson, not the design to copy. Convergence: layered resolution, models.dev-grade shared data, refresh-proof per-model user overrides, effort ladders with per-model gating, separate extended-window field. fa already owns the ladder (#273), the reserve math (16384), the remote+live catalog merge (`remote_catalog.dart`: fa1.dev JSON + `/v1/models`, endpoint wins, never blocks), and role slots — the missing 20% is the precedence resolver, the per-provider+model override section, and the two edit surfaces. ## Architecture **ModelCapabilityResolver** (pure function, one call): ``` resolve(provider, modelId, roleSlot?) → EffectiveCaps{ contextWindow, maxTokens, thinkingLevel, maxTokensField, omitMaxOutputTokens } ``` Layer precedence (first explicit value wins per field): 1. **per-provider+model user override** — `models: overrides: : : {contextWindow, maxTokens, thinkingLevel}` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` (kimi-style: survives every catalog refresh; strict `ConfigException` on bad shape, like every `models:` key today); 2. **endpoint-published truth** — `/v1/models` fields where the endpoint publishes them (already merged by `RemoteCatalogEnrichment`; extend to output caps where present); 3. **shared catalog** — remote fa1.dev catalog (existing), enriched toward models.dev-grade coverage; 4. **role slot** — `roles:` chain entries already accept `thinkingLevel` (#734); extend with the same cap keys, per slot (default/smol/slow/plan + media slots); 5. **global clamp** — `agent.contextWindowCap` applies LAST as today (#729 semantics preserved: clamp down, raise to served truth). Thinking precedence: model pin > role slot > global default > model-declared default; unsupported rung on a `reasoning:false` model → gated with a loud note (never silently sent). # gh-1426: [GOAL] Model capability negotiation: layered context-window / max-output / thinking resolver with per-provider+model overrides in CLI and app settings ## Description ## Goal — Model capability negotiation (v1) One sentence: **every model fa talks to resolves its context window, max output tokens, and thinking level through ONE layered resolver — endpoint truth → shared catalog → per-provider+model user override → role slot → global cap — with the same override editable from the CLI /settings flow and the app settings, so a hand-coded 200k/16k catalog guess never strands a big-window, big-output, or thinking model again.** Today's pain, measured on fa main: `provider_catalog.dart:110-129` hand-hardcodes `contextWindow: 200000, maxTokens: 16384` for kimi/z.ai (the exact 200k/16k the owner sees); the thinking ladder is fully ported (`thinking.dart`, #273: budgets 1024/2048/8192/16384, `xhigh/max`→`high`) and config-reachable (#734: roles chain, `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`) but has **no chat-model surface in /settings and no per-model pin**; `CustomModelDefinition` accepts `contextWindow`/`maxTokens` but **no `thinkingLevel`**, and only for custom models — catalog models (glm, kimi, z.ai) have no override path at all; the only manual window correction is the GLOBAL `agent.contextWindowCap` (`settings_flow.dart:1935-2099`). ## Why this framing Not "add a thinking setting" (too thin — the same gap exists for window and output), not "auto-detect everything" (endpoints lie and users must be able to correct). The framing is a single precedence-resolved capability triple per (provider, model) — the convergent design all four references reached independently. ## Reference intelligence (pinned, per repo) - **pi** (`/references/pi`): code-generated catalog from **models.dev** (`scripts/generate-models.ts` → `models.generated.ts`); per-model user overrides in `models.json`; thinking config keys `defaultThinkingLevel` + `modelThinkingLevels` + `thinkingBudgets` + `"model:level"` CLI suffix; max output = catalog `maxTokens` clamped to window (floor 4096); unknown/custom models → **128000/16384 defaults**; adapter field selection (`max_tokens` vs `max_completion_tokens` vs `max_output_tokens` vs `maxOutputTokens`). - **oh-my-pi** (`/references/oh-my-pi`): layered pipeline models.json → SQLite cache → **models.dev/API discovery merge** → user `modelOverrides` → hardcoded policy fixes, **lazy re-probe after selection**; override shape `providers.

.modelOverrides..{contextWindow,maxTokens,thinking}` in `~/.omp/agent/models.yml`; **`maxContextWindow`** (extended context as a separate field) and **`omitMaxOutputTokens`** (endpoints that REJECT the field); per-model thinking gating `ThinkingConfig` (mode/efforts/effortMap/effortBudgets/effortRouting); merge precedence suffix > role > settings > model default; roles smol/slow/plan/tiny/advisor. - **kimi-code** (`/references/kimi-code`): 3-layer source (`/models` API → **persisted TOML**, models.dev snapshot, hardcoded anthropic output ceilings); **`max_context_size` required + build-time validated**; **`overrides` sub-table that SURVIVES catalog refreshes**; `[thinking]` section (enabled/effort/forced_effort/keep) + per-model `support_efforts`/`default_effort`/`off_effort`/`adaptive_thinking`; subagent-only role slots (`[secondary_model]`). - **codex** (`/references/codex`): server-driven `ModelInfo` catalog (`codex-rs/models-manager/`), **272k fallback record** for unknown slugs; `ReasoningEffort` None…Ultra/Custom, default Medium; keys `model_reasoning_effort` + **`plan_mode_reasoning_effort` (separate plan-role effort)** + `model_reasoning_summary` + `model_verbosity`; gating via catalog `supported_reasoning_levels`; mid-stream effort updates; `context_window`/`max_context_window` with 95% usable; user override `model_context_window` clamped to max; auto-compact at 90%; **max output REMOVED entirely** (Responses API manages it) — the compat lesson, not the design to copy. Convergence: layered resolution, models.dev-grade shared data, refresh-proof per-model user overrides, effort ladders with per-model gating, separate extended-window field. fa already owns the ladder (#273), the reserve math (16384), the remote+live catalog merge (`remote_catalog.dart`: fa1.dev JSON + `/v1/models`, endpoint wins, never blocks), and role slots — the missing 20% is the precedence resolver, the per-provider+model override section, and the two edit surfaces. ## Architecture **ModelCapabilityResolver** (pure function, one call): ``` resolve(provider, modelId, roleSlot?) → EffectiveCaps{ contextWindow, maxTokens, thinkingLevel, maxTokensField, omitMaxOutputTokens } ``` Layer precedence (first explicit value wins per field): 1. **per-provider+model user override** — `models: overrides: : : {contextWindow, maxTokens, thinkingLevel}` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` (kimi-style: survives every catalog refresh; strict `ConfigException` on bad shape, like every `models:` key today); 2. **endpoint-published truth** — `/v1/models` fields where the endpoint publishes them (already merged by `RemoteCatalogEnrichment`; extend to output caps where present); 3. **shared catalog** — remote fa1.dev catalog (existing), enriched toward models.dev-grade coverage; 4. **role slot** — `roles:` chain entries already accept `thinkingLevel` (#734); extend with the same cap keys, per slot (default/smol/slow/plan + media slots); 5. **global clamp** — `agent.contextWindowCap` applies LAST as today (#729 semantics preserved: clamp down, raise to served truth). Thinking precedence: model pin > role slot > global default > model-declared default; unsupported rung on a `reasoning:false` model → gated with a loud note (never silently sent). Compat: `maxTokensField` selection exists; add the `omitMaxOutputTokens` escape (omp/codex lesson: some endpoints reject the field). ## Capability surface (subject of every verb) | capability | acts on | shape | |---|---|---| | resolve | the **capability triple** for a (provider, model, role) | pure resolver, one precedence, property-tested | | override | **catalog models per provider+model** | `models: overrides:` section, refresh-proof, strict parse | | edit (CLI) | the **override entry** via /settings → model config → pick provider → pick model → caps | persisted to the same keys the resolver reads | | edit (app) | the **same override entry** in app settings screens | same config file, one source of truth (no parallel store) | | pin | **role slots** (smol/slow/plan + media) | same cap keys + thinkingLevel per slot; plan effort separable | | probe | the **endpoint's published caps** | existing remote-catalog merge, extended to output caps; lazy, never blocking | | gate | the **thinking rung** against the model's declared support | loud fallback note on mismatch | | omit | the **max-output field** for rejecting endpoints | `omitMaxOutputTokens` compat flag | Tiering: **core** = resolver + overrides section + CLI edit flow + app edit flow + role-slot cap keys + thinking serialization end-to-end + gating note. **Second tier** = models.dev-grade catalog enrichment, lazy re-probe after selection, `maxContextWindow` extended-context field, mid-stream effort updates, adaptive thinking, per-verbosity. **Excluded** (rationale each): removing max output entirely (codex's API manages it; our endpoints differ — glm/kimi need explicit caps), new model-picker UI (extend the existing `/model` + custom-provider flows), auto model selection (out of scope), prompt-content changes. ## Acceptance criteria (testable) - **AC1** — resolver precedence: for every field, the first explicit layer wins; a property test drives all 5 layers × set/unset combinations and asserts the winner (fixture table, no IO). - **AC2** — the owner's exact pain: with `models: overrides: zai: glm-5.3-flash: {maxTokens: 65536, thinkingLevel: high}`, the outbound request carries the raised cap and the level; the ctx meter and compaction thresholds see the same numbers (one resolver, three consumers). - **AC3** — CLI edit flow: /settings → model config → provider → model → caps persists exactly the resolver's override keys; # gh-1426: [GOAL] Model capability negotiation: layered context-window / max-output / thinking resolver with per-provider+model overrides in CLI and app settings ## Description ## Goal — Model capability negotiation (v1) One sentence: **every model fa talks to resolves its context window, max output tokens, and thinking level through ONE layered resolver — endpoint truth → shared catalog → per-provider+model user override → role slot → global cap — with the same override editable from the CLI /settings flow and the app settings, so a hand-coded 200k/16k catalog guess never strands a big-window, big-output, or thinking model again.** Today's pain, measured on fa main: `provider_catalog.dart:110-129` hand-hardcodes `contextWindow: 200000, maxTokens: 16384` for kimi/z.ai (the exact 200k/16k the owner sees); the thinking ladder is fully ported (`thinking.dart`, #273: budgets 1024/2048/8192/16384, `xhigh/max`→`high`) and config-reachable (#734: roles chain, `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`) but has **no chat-model surface in /settings and no per-model pin**; `CustomModelDefinition` accepts `contextWindow`/`maxTokens` but **no `thinkingLevel`**, and only for custom models — catalog models (glm, kimi, z.ai) have no override path at all; the only manual window correction is the GLOBAL `agent.contextWindowCap` (`settings_flow.dart:1935-2099`). ## Why this framing Not "add a thinking setting" (too thin — the same gap exists for window and output), not "auto-detect everything" (endpoints lie and users must be able to correct). The framing is a single precedence-resolved capability triple per (provider, model) — the convergent design all four references reached independently. ## Reference intelligence (pinned, per repo) - **pi** (`/references/pi`): code-generated catalog from **models.dev** (`scripts/generate-models.ts` → `models.generated.ts`); per-model user overrides in `models.json`; thinking config keys `defaultThinkingLevel` + `modelThinkingLevels` + `thinkingBudgets` + `"model:level"` CLI suffix; max output = catalog `maxTokens` clamped to window (floor 4096); unknown/custom models → **128000/16384 defaults**; adapter field selection (`max_tokens` vs `max_completion_tokens` vs `max_output_tokens` vs `maxOutputTokens`). - **oh-my-pi** (`/references/oh-my-pi`): layered pipeline models.json → SQLite cache → **models.dev/API discovery merge** → user `modelOverrides` → hardcoded policy fixes, **lazy re-probe after selection**; override shape `providers.

.modelOverrides..{contextWindow,maxTokens,thinking}` in `~/.omp/agent/models.yml`; **`maxContextWindow`** (extended context as a separate field) and **`omitMaxOutputTokens`** (endpoints that REJECT the field); per-model thinking gating `ThinkingConfig` (mode/efforts/effortMap/effortBudgets/effortRouting); merge precedence suffix > role > settings > model default; roles smol/slow/plan/tiny/advisor. - **kimi-code** (`/references/kimi-code`): 3-layer source (`/models` API → **persisted TOML**, models.dev snapshot, hardcoded anthropic output ceilings); **`max_context_size` required + build-time validated**; **`overrides` sub-table that SURVIVES catalog refreshes**; `[thinking]` section (enabled/effort/forced_effort/keep) + per-model `support_efforts`/`default_effort`/`off_effort`/`adaptive_thinking`; subagent-only role slots (`[secondary_model]`). - **codex** (`/references/codex`): server-driven `ModelInfo` catalog (`codex-rs/models-manager/`), **272k fallback record** for unknown slugs; `ReasoningEffort` None…Ultra/Custom, default Medium; keys `model_reasoning_effort` + **`plan_mode_reasoning_effort` (separate plan-role effort)** + `model_reasoning_summary` + `model_verbosity`; gating via catalog `supported_reasoning_levels`; mid-stream effort updates; `context_window`/`max_context_window` with 95% usable; user override `model_context_window` clamped to max; auto-compact at 90%; **max output REMOVED entirely** (Responses API manages it) — the compat lesson, not the design to copy. Convergence: layered resolution, models.dev-grade shared data, refresh-proof per-model user overrides, effort ladders with per-model gating, separate extended-window field. fa already owns the ladder (#273), the reserve math (16384), the remote+live catalog merge (`remote_catalog.dart`: fa1.dev JSON + `/v1/models`, endpoint wins, never blocks), and role slots — the missing 20% is the precedence resolver, the per-provider+model override section, and the two edit surfaces. ## Architecture **ModelCapabilityResolver** (pure function, one call): ``` resolve(provider, modelId, roleSlot?) → EffectiveCaps{ contextWindow, maxTokens, thinkingLevel, maxTokensField, omitMaxOutputTokens } ``` Layer precedence (first explicit value wins per field): 1. **per-provider+model user override** — `models: overrides: : : {contextWindow, maxTokens, thinkingLevel}` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` (kimi-style: survives every catalog refresh; strict `ConfigException` on bad shape, like every `models:` key today); 2. **endpoint-published truth** — `/v1/models` fields where the endpoint publishes them (already merged by `RemoteCatalogEnrichment`; extend to output caps where present); 3. **shared catalog** — remote fa1.dev catalog (existing), enriched toward models.dev-grade coverage; 4. **role slot** — `roles:` chain entries already accept `thinkingLevel` (#734); extend with the same cap keys, per slot (default/smol/slow/plan + media slots); 5. **global clamp** — `agent.contextWindowCap` applies LAST as today (#729 semantics preserved: clamp down, raise to served truth). Thinking precedence: model pin > role slot > global default > model-declared default; unsupported rung on a `reasoning:false` model → gated with a loud note (never silently sent). Compat: `maxTokensField` selection exists; add the `omitMaxOutputTokens` escape (omp/codex lesson: some endpoints reject the field). ## Capability surface (subject of every verb) | capability | acts on | shape | |---|---|---| | resolve | the **capability triple** for a (provider, model, role) | pure resolver, one precedence, property-tested | | override | **catalog models per provider+model** | `models: overrides:` section, refresh-proof, strict parse | | edit (CLI) | the **override entry** via /settings → model config → pick provider → pick model → caps | persisted to the same keys the resolver reads | | edit (app) | the **same override entry** in app settings screens | same config file, one source of truth (no parallel store) | | pin | **role slots** (smol/slow/plan + media) | same cap keys + thinkingLevel per slot; plan effort separable | | probe | the **endpoint's published caps** | existing remote-catalog merge, extended to output caps; lazy, never blocking | | gate | the **thinking rung** against the model's declared support | loud fallback note on mismatch | | omit | the **max-output field** for rejecting endpoints | `omitMaxOutputTokens` compat flag | Tiering: **core** = resolver + overrides section + CLI edit flow + app edit flow + role-slot cap keys + thinking serialization end-to-end + gating note. **Second tier** = models.dev-grade catalog enrichment, lazy re-probe after selection, `maxContextWindow` extended-context field, mid-stream effort updates, adaptive thinking, per-verbosity. **Excluded** (rationale each): removing max output entirely (codex's API manages it; our endpoints differ — glm/kimi need explicit caps), new model-picker UI (extend the existing `/model` + custom-provider flows), auto model selection (out of scope), prompt-content changes. ## Acceptance criteria (testable) - **AC1** — resolver precedence: for every field, the first explicit layer wins; a property test drives all 5 layers × set/unset combinations and asserts the winner (fixture table, no IO). - **AC2** — the owner's exact pain: with `models: overrides: zai: glm-5.3-flash: {maxTokens: 65536, thinkingLevel: high}`, the outbound request carries the raised cap and the level; # gh-1426: [GOAL] Model capability negotiation: layered context-window / max-output / thinking resolver with per-provider+model overrides in CLI and app settings ## Description ## Goal — Model capability negotiation (v1) One sentence: **every model fa talks to resolves its context window, max output tokens, and thinking level through ONE layered resolver — endpoint truth → shared catalog → per-provider+model user override → role slot → global cap — with the same override editable from the CLI /settings flow and the app settings, so a hand-coded 200k/16k catalog guess never strands a big-window, big-output, or thinking model again.** Today's pain, measured on fa main: `provider_catalog.dart:110-129` hand-hardcodes `contextWindow: 200000, maxTokens: 16384` for kimi/z.ai (the exact 200k/16k the owner sees); the thinking ladder is fully ported (`thinking.dart`, #273: budgets 1024/2048/8192/16384, `xhigh/max`→`high`) and config-reachable (#734: roles chain, `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`) but has **no chat-model surface in /settings and no per-model pin**; `CustomModelDefinition` accepts `contextWindow`/`maxTokens` but **no `thinkingLevel`**, and only for custom models — catalog models (glm, kimi, z.ai) have no override path at all; the only manual window correction is the GLOBAL `agent.contextWindowCap` (`settings_flow.dart:1935-2099`). ## Why this framing Not "add a thinking setting" (too thin — the same gap exists for window and output), not "auto-detect everything" (endpoints lie and users must be able to correct). The framing is a single precedence-resolved capability triple per (provider, model) — the convergent design all four references reached independently. ## Reference intelligence (pinned, per repo) - **pi** (`/references/pi`): code-generated catalog from **models.dev** (`scripts/generate-models.ts` → `models.generated.ts`); per-model user overrides in `models.json`; thinking config keys `defaultThinkingLevel` + `modelThinkingLevels` + `thinkingBudgets` + `"model:level"` CLI suffix; max output = catalog `maxTokens` clamped to window (floor 4096); unknown/custom models → **128000/16384 defaults**; adapter field selection (`max_tokens` vs `max_completion_tokens` vs `max_output_tokens` vs `maxOutputTokens`). - **oh-my-pi** (`/references/oh-my-pi`): layered pipeline models.json → SQLite cache → **models.dev/API discovery merge** → user `modelOverrides` → hardcoded policy fixes, **lazy re-probe after selection**; override shape `providers.

.modelOverrides..{contextWindow,maxTokens,thinking}` in `~/.omp/agent/models.yml`; **`maxContextWindow`** (extended context as a separate field) and **`omitMaxOutputTokens`** (endpoints that REJECT the field); per-model thinking gating `ThinkingConfig` (mode/efforts/effortMap/effortBudgets/effortRouting); merge precedence suffix > role > settings > model default; roles smol/slow/plan/tiny/advisor. - **kimi-code** (`/references/kimi-code`): 3-layer source (`/models` API → **persisted TOML**, models.dev snapshot, hardcoded anthropic output ceilings); **`max_context_size` required + build-time validated**; **`overrides` sub-table that SURVIVES catalog refreshes**; `[thinking]` section (enabled/effort/forced_effort/keep) + per-model `support_efforts`/`default_effort`/`off_effort`/`adaptive_thinking`; subagent-only role slots (`[secondary_model]`). - **codex** (`/references/codex`): server-driven `ModelInfo` catalog (`codex-rs/models-manager/`), **272k fallback record** for unknown slugs; `ReasoningEffort` None…Ultra/Custom, default Medium; keys `model_reasoning_effort` + **`plan_mode_reasoning_effort` (separate plan-role effort)** + `model_reasoning_summary` + `model_verbosity`; gating via catalog `supported_reasoning_levels`; mid-stream effort updates; `context_window`/`max_context_window` with 95% usable; user override `model_context_window` clamped to max; auto-compact at 90%; **max output REMOVED entirely** (Responses API manages it) — the compat lesson, not the design to copy. Convergence: layered resolution, models.dev-grade shared data, refresh-proof per-model user overrides, effort ladders with per-model gating, separate extended-window field. fa already owns the ladder (#273), the reserve math (16384), the remote+live catalog merge (`remote_catalog.dart`: fa1.dev JSON + `/v1/models`, endpoint wins, never blocks), and role slots — the missing 20% is the precedence resolver, the per-provider+model override section, and the two edit surfaces. ## Architecture **ModelCapabilityResolver** (pure function, one call): ``` resolve(provider, modelId, roleSlot?) → EffectiveCaps{ contextWindow, maxTokens, thinkingLevel, maxTokensField, omitMaxOutputTokens } ``` Layer precedence (first explicit value wins per field): 1. **per-provider+model user override** — `models: overrides: : : {contextWindow, maxTokens, thinkingLevel}` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` (kimi-style: survives every catalog refresh; strict `ConfigException` on bad shape, like every `models:` key today); 2. **endpoint-published truth** — `/v1/models` fields where the endpoint publishes them (already merged by `RemoteCatalogEnrichment`; extend to output caps where present); 3. **shared catalog** — remote fa1.dev catalog (existing), enriched toward models.dev-grade coverage; 4. **role slot** — `roles:` chain entries already accept `thinkingLevel` (#734); extend with the same cap keys, per slot (default/smol/slow/plan + media slots); 5. **global clamp** — `agent.contextWindowCap` applies LAST as today (#729 semantics preserved: clamp down, raise to served truth). Thinking precedence: model pin > role slot > global default > model-declared default; unsupported rung on a `reasoning:false` model → gated with a loud note (never silently sent). Compat: `maxTokensField` selection exists; add the `omitMaxOutputTokens` escape (omp/codex lesson: some endpoints reject the field). ## Capability surface (subject of every verb) | capability | acts on | shape | |---|---|---| | resolve | the **capability triple** for a (provider, model, role) | pure resolver, one precedence, property-tested | | override | **catalog models per provider+model** | `models: overrides:` section, refresh-proof, strict parse | | edit (CLI) | the **override entry** via /settings → model config → pick provider → pick model → caps | persisted to the same keys the resolver reads | | edit (app) | the **same override entry** in app settings screens | same config file, one source of truth (no parallel store) | | pin | **role slots** (smol/slow/plan + media) | same cap keys + thinkingLevel per slot; plan effort separable | | probe | the **endpoint's published caps** | existing remote-catalog merge, extended to output caps; lazy, never blocking | | gate | the **thinking rung** against the model's declared support | loud fallback note on mismatch | | omit | the **max-output field** for rejecting endpoints | `omitMaxOutputTokens` compat flag | Tiering: **core** = resolver + overrides section + CLI edit flow + app edit flow + role-slot cap keys + thinking serialization end-to-end + gating note. **Second tier** = models.dev-grade catalog enrichment, lazy re-probe after selection, `maxContextWindow` extended-context field, mid-stream effort updates, adaptive thinking, per-verbosity. **Excluded** (rationale each): removing max output entirely (codex's API manages it; our endpoints differ — glm/kimi need explicit caps), new model-picker UI (extend the existing `/model` + custom-provider flows), auto model selection (out of scope), prompt-content changes. ## Acceptance criteria (testable) - **AC1** — resolver precedence: for every field, the first explicit layer wins; a property test drives all 5 layers × set/unset combinations and asserts the winner (fixture table, no IO). - **AC2** — the owner's exact pain: with `models: overrides: zai: glm-5.3-flash: {maxTokens: 65536, thinkingLevel: high}`, the outbound request carries the raised cap and the level; the ctx meter and compaction thresholds see the same numbers (one resolver, three consumers). - **AC3** — CLI edit flow: /settings → model config → provider → model → caps persists exactly the resolver's override keys;
